title: Join PERMAFLEET
description: Walks a new G00N SQUAD member through applying to PERMAFLEET on RSI and tells leadership who they are, so they can be tagged Prospect I (offered by the welcome DMs in contracts/welcome.json). Answers are recorded per member for PERMAFLEET leadership.

welcome.say: Hi {{user.name}}! Joining PERMAFLEET takes two steps: apply to the org on RSI, then tell leadership a little about yourself so they can match your application and tag you **Prospect I**. Nothing is sent until you confirm at the end, and Cancel stops at any point.

rsi.say: First, apply on RSI: open https://robertsspaceindustries.com/orgs/PERMAFLEET and choose **Join us now!** Where are you with that?

options.label: I'm already in PERMAFLEET on RSI

handle.say: What's your RSI handle? It's the name in your RSI profile link (robertsspaceindustries.com/citizens/<handle>), and it's how leadership finds your application.

org.say: Are you in another Star Citizen org?

options.label: No, PERMAFLEET will be my first
Yes, a PERMAFLEET member org
options.description: G00N, INFN, TRDE, LCRP, Doubledog, 4M, Risky Business

experience.say: How long have you been playing Star Citizen?

options.label: A few months to a year

interests.say: What do you like to do? Pick everything that fits.

when.say: When do you usually play (your local time)? Pick everything that fits.

notes.say: Anything else leadership should know? Who invited you, past orgs, what you're hoping to find. Skip if not.

complete.say: Sent. Once leadership finds your RSI application they'll tag you **Prospect I** on Discord, and you move up by showing up: this week's ops are at {{context.siteUrl|https://goon.vc}}/operations/PERMAFLEET/schedule, and the PERMAFLEET voice channel is open any time. If you haven't applied on RSI yet, do it now: https://robertsspaceindustries.com/orgs/PERMAFLEET

cancelled.say: No problem, nothing was sent. Whenever you're ready, apply at https://robertsspaceindustries.com/orgs/PERMAFLEET; how the ranks work is at {{context.siteUrl|https://goon.vc}}/operations/PERMAFLEET/squadrons
